author: Prof. Aditya Verma (rnd-head, E-011)
steering: Wave-4/5 learnings: (1) the one W5 win was W5-02 implied-borrow-cost as a CONVEX HEDGE (worst-decile-mkt-month LS +3.5%, COVID +4.4%, weak linear IC) - this batch is biased toward more counterparty-information / authenticity / tail-protective mechanisms; (2) ZERO momentum/trend variants (Principal directive: momentum rescues = dead end, ~1 crowded bet, 76-78% short leg unborrowable); (3) killed and NOT re-proposed: cyclical-EY, sector-rotation, plain PEAD, NOA, reinvestment_runway (W4G, IC_IR -0.41 wrong-sign), moat_margin_stability (W4G), distress composite (W4B-02 sign-unstable); (4) every construction below verified against the 34 on-disk metric_norm uniques in data/fundamentals/MASTER_fundamentals_pit.parquet (re-verified 2026-07-17: full-coverage ~48-49k rows for BS/P&L core; CF set + dividend payout % ~750-firm / ~7.6k-row subsets; financing-schema fields 1,158 rows - flagged where used); (5) forensic data-blocked patterns (pledge, rating trajectory, auditor resignation, RPT/ICD) are DATA-ASKS in batch_summary, not hypotheses.
evaluation_directive: CONVEXITY FIX (W5-02 lesson): the W5 verdict logic labeled implied-borrow-cost 'not convex' from UNCONDITIONAL skew while its worst-decile-market-month conditional LS was +3.5% - the primary pre-registered convexity statistic for W6 is mean_LS_worst_decile_mkt_months and episode conditional means (COVID/2022; GFC where coverage exists), NOT unconditional skew. Hard gates lag+placebo only; PBO/DSR advisory (low-t rule); rank on RECONCILED net-LS once queue item 5 lands. Payoff shape per TAIL_CONVEXITY.md mandatory on every card. All candidates are NEXT-SLEEVE / overlay material on their own forward clock; the frozen 7-leg is never touched.
trials_note: One base construction + at most ONE pre-registered refinement per idea (H002 lesson). Log every run in trials_counter under its own family id. Ideas W6-01/02/03/05 overlap the H040 forensic-composite flag space (universe_forensic.py computes other-income dependence + tax-rate anomaly as FLAGS): enumerate H040's components and run corr vs the H040 composite BEFORE spending on any of them; if corr > 0.6 treat as H040 attribution work, not a new family.

hypotheses.name: Investment-book yield authenticity (phantom-cash tell)
hypotheses.mechanism: Satyam/Cox&Kings pattern (FRAUD_CASE_LIBRARY #1, #9): reported cash-and-investments that do not generate plausible investment income are not really there - tied up in related-party instruments or fabricated. A large reported investment book yielding anomalously little 'other income' is the cheapest on-disk reality-check of the balance sheet's most fakeable asset. Cox&Kings defaulted weeks after reporting a large cash pile.
hypotheses.construction: implied_yield_t = other income_t / (0.5*(investments_t + investments_{t-1})); require avg investments / total assets >= 10% (else NaN - yield meaningless for thin books). Factor = penalty-only: for qualifying firms, z_cs(implied_yield) winsorized at [0%, 25%], long HIGH yield (authentic books), i.e. avoid LOW-yield-large-book names. Fields: other income, investments, total assets. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_sign: + for high implied yield (cash is real); the money is expected on the SHORT/avoidance side
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: CONVEX via short-leg blowup avoidance: phantom-cash names gap down on default/forensic revelation events. Pre-register: bottom-quintile (low-yield-large-book) conditional return in worst-decile market months and in credit-stress episodes (2018 NBFC, 2020) << universe. Grade on conditional stress payoff per the batch evaluation_directive, not unconditional skew.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg_and_w5: No 7-leg touches investment-income yield. Nearest: quality_cfo_pat (earnings-authenticity family - expect corr < 0.3, verify) and W5-04 net-financial-slack (uses the LEVEL of investments; this is the AUTHENTICITY/yield of the same book - corr check vs the parked W5-04 construct mandatory). Known noise: other income includes forex/asset-sale one-offs - disclosed, part of why penalty-only framing is used.
hypotheses.why_distinct: First signal in the program that cross-checks a balance-sheet ASSET against the income it should throw off - a reality-reconciliation channel (like clean-surplus for earnings, but for the cash/investment book). Fraud-library rank-1-adjacent (§B 'cash & investments reality' is the taxonomy's own named flag, never built as a factor).
hypotheses.refinement: Add borrowings condition: penalty intensified when low-yield-large-book coincides with high borrowings/total assets (the 'large cash + high debt = suspicious' §B flag verbatim - why hold expensive debt against fake cash?).
hypotheses.data_status: buildable-now (other income + investments full coverage ~49k rows)

hypotheses.name: Revenue-mix drift / business-model-mix anomaly (Ricoh-Cox&Kings pattern)
hypotheses.mechanism: FRAUD_CASE_LIBRARY cross-case synthesis names 'business-model-mix anomalies' as an un-owned category: a company suddenly booking material income in a line UNRELATED to its stated core business (Ricoh: hardware co booking leasing income; Cox&Kings: travel co running a forex-card lending arm; Karvy: broker with property-scale debt). On-disk, the codable shadow of this is a sharp RISE in non-operating income share while core operating profit stagnates - profit increasingly coming from somewhere other than the business the market thinks it owns.
hypotheses.construction: mix_t = other income_t / (other income_t + max(operating profit_t, 0)); drift = mix_t - median(mix_{t-3..t-1}); penalty gate: drift > 0 AND d_ln(operating profit, 3Y) < d_ln(other income, 3Y). Factor = -z_cs(drift) under the gate (long LOW drift / clean-mix names). Fields: other income, operating profit, sales. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: CONVEX via avoidance: mix-drift names carry governance/restatement tail events (Ricoh restated profit into loss). Payoff expected lumpy/episodic - evaluate event-style conditional returns alongside monthly LS; primary statistic = worst-decile-month conditional mean per evaluation_directive.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg_and_w5: No 7-leg touches income COMPOSITION. vs W5-05 treasury-bloat: W5-05 is the BALANCE-SHEET side (where the marginal rupee of assets went); this is the P&L side (where the profit now comes from) - corr check between the two mandatory if both pass. vs H040: universe_forensic computes an other-income-dependence FLAG - enumerate + corr vs H040 composite before spend (trials_note).
hypotheses.why_distinct: The explicitly-requested diworsification/revenue-mix-drift mechanism from the fraud library; nothing in ~500 trials asks WHAT KIND of profit a firm books, only how much. Distinct from growth/margin checks and from all authenticity legs (which reconcile totals, not mix).
hypotheses.refinement: Schema-switch event flag: firms whose fundamentals rows ADD financing-schema fields (financing profit / financing margin % / revenue, 1,158 rows on disk) after years of a sales/operating-profit history = literal Ricoh-pattern event (industrial co reclassifying as part-financier). Thin coverage - event-study read only, disclosed.
hypotheses.data_status: buildable-now (other income + operating profit full coverage; financing-schema refinement on 1,158-row subset, disclosed)

hypotheses.name: Stale-CWIP: capex that never capitalizes
hypotheses.mechanism: Coverage map's own named GAP-UNTESTED forensic tell ('CWIP-to-assets that never capitalizes', 08_FORENSICS_REDFLAGS L16), now verified buildable (cwip populated 49,274 rows). Capital-work-in-progress that stays large for years without converting into fixed assets is the classic footprint of gold-plated/fictitious/stalled capex and of promoter fund-diversion through construction contracts (DHFL/IL&FS-adjacent). Honest capex converts; fake capex accumulates.
hypotheses.construction: For trailing 3 FYs: cwip_ratio_t = cwip_t / (fixed assets_t + cwip_t); stale = min(cwip_ratio over 3Y) with the additional condition d_ln(fixed assets, 3Y) < 0.10 (CWIP high AND nothing capitalizing). Factor = -z_cs(stale) under the condition, long LOW stale-CWIP. Require cwip_ratio >= 5% for signal (else NaN). Fields: cwip, fixed assets. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: CONVEX via avoidance: diversion/impairment revelations are gap-down events. Pre-register bottom-quintile conditional stress-month return << universe; episodic evaluation alongside monthly IC.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg_and_w5: No 7-leg or W5 candidate touches CWIP. bs_asset_growth uses TOTAL asset growth (quantity); this is the QUALITY/conversion of the capex component - corr vs bs_asset_growth mandatory (shared field family), expect < 0.3. Distinct from killed reinvestment_runway (that scored ROIC x reinvestment LEVEL; this scores whether claimed investment turns into productive assets at all).
hypotheses.why_distinct: Asset-side authenticity - the capex mirror of clean-surplus (earnings-side) and W6-01 (cash-side). Completes the reality-reconciliation family across the three most fakeable statement blocks.
hypotheses.refinement: Interaction with borrowings growth: stale-CWIP funded by RISING debt (borrowings up >15%/yr while CWIP sits unconverted) = the debt-diversion variant, penalty intensified.
hypotheses.data_status: buildable-now (cwip 49,274 rows, fixed assets 49,280 - full coverage verified 2026-07-17)

hypotheses.name: Extend-and-pretend: cash interest coverage with rising debt
hypotheses.mechanism: Kingfisher/Educomp pattern (fraud library #13, #14, and rank-1 cross-case pattern 7/15 cases): persistent inability to cover interest from OPERATING CASH (not accrual EBIT), funded by ever-larger fresh borrowing, is visible years before collapse. Accrual-based distress scoring died (W4B-02 sign-unstable) because accruals are the thing being manipulated; cash interest coverage uses the un-fakeable numerator.
hypotheses.construction: cash_cover = sum(cash from operating activity, 3Y) / sum(interest, 3Y) on the CF subset; penalty flag = cash_cover < 1 AND borrowings_t > 1.2*borrowings_{t-3}. Factor = penalty-only: -z_cs(intensity = (1 - min(cash_cover,1)) * borrowings growth) for flagged names, 0 otherwise. Fields: cash from operating activity (subset), interest, borrowings. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: CONVEX via short-leg avoidance, concentrated in credit-tightening episodes (2013 taper, 2018 IL&FS, 2022 hikes) - same episode set where W5-02 paid. Pre-register conditional crash-month mean as primary.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg_and_w5: vs QMJ (leverage LEVEL), vs W5-02 (PRICE of debt - lender's assessment), vs W5-07 borrowed-dividends (distribution-specific): this is cash SERVICEABILITY of debt - a fourth distinct credit-channel quantity. vs quality_cfo_pat: CFO-vs-PAT is authenticity; CFO-vs-INTEREST is solvency - corr check mandatory (shared CFO numerator, ~750-firm subset).
hypotheses.why_distinct: The cash-flow-based resurrection of what the accrual distress composite got wrong - penalty-only, event-style, no long-leg claim. Explicitly NOT a rebuild of W4B-02 (different numerator, penalty-only design, episode-graded).
hypotheses.data_status: buildable-limited (CFO ~7,634 rows / ~750 firms - disclose coverage like the CFO/PAT leg)

hypotheses.name: Effective-tax authenticity (the tax authority's information set)
hypotheses.mechanism: W5-02's win came from importing the CREDIT market's private information. The same template applied to a second counterparty: the TAX authority. Fake profits are expensive to fake taxes on - a firm persistently reporting high accounting profit while paying an anomalously low effective tax rate is either structurally advantaged (real, disclosed) or its P&L is not what the assessing officer sees. Cross-sectional z per date is immune to statutory-regime shifts (2019 cut).
hypotheses.construction: eff_tax = median(tax %, trailing 3 FYs) for firms with profit before tax > 0 in >= 2 of 3 FYs. Factor = z_cs(eff_tax residualized on sector), long HIGH tax-payers (earnings certified by cash tax), penalty concentrated in bottom-decile-tax x positive-PBT names. Winsorize tax % at [0, 50]. Fields: tax %, profit before tax. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: CONVEX via short-leg avoidance (phantom-profit names). Known drag risk: legitimately tax-advantaged sectors/zones (SEZ, 80IA infra) - sector residualization is the control; report sector-attribution explicitly.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg_and_w5: No 7-leg uses tax. Nearest mechanism-neighbor: clean-surplus (retained-earnings reconciliation) and quality_cfo_pat (cash reconciliation) - this is a THIRD independent verification channel (government's). H040 caveat applies (tax-rate anomaly is a universe_forensic FLAG - corr vs H040 composite first, per trials_note).
hypotheses.why_distinct: Counterparty-certification template (the batch's exploit of the W5-02 lesson) applied to the only other counterparty with skin in the game visible on disk.
hypotheses.refinement: Tax-rate COLLAPSE event: eff_tax dropping > 15pp vs own 3Y median while reported PBT grows - the flow version - only if level passes gates.

hypotheses.name: Pseudo-working-capital intensity drift (other-assets-to-sales)
hypotheses.mechanism: True receivables/DSO/inventory splits are data-blocked, but the screener balance-sheet identity (total = fixed + cwip + investments + other assets) makes 'other assets' a coarse superset of working capital + loans-and-advances. A firm whose other-assets-per-rupee-of-sales ratchets up is absorbing cash into receivables/inventory/advances faster than it sells - the Educomp/PC Jeweller footprint. Contamination by cash cuts both ways: loans-and-advances contamination IS the related-party-advance channel (Cox&Kings).
hypotheses.construction: wc_intensity_t = other assets_t / sales_t; drift = wc_intensity_t / median(wc_intensity_{t-3..t-1}) - 1. Factor = -z_cs(drift), long LOW drift (efficient converters), require sales > 0 and wc_intensity in [0.05, 5] (else NaN). Fields: other assets, sales. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Mildly convex via avoidance (working-capital blowups precede defaults); expect some linear IC too (efficiency is partially priced). Report both; primary read still the conditional stress payoff.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg_and_w5: vs bs_asset_growth: that is TOTAL asset growth; this is the intensity of the non-fixed, non-investment block RELATIVE TO SALES (a ratio drift, not a growth rate) - corr check mandatory, kill if > 0.6. vs W5-05 treasury bloat (investments composition - different asset block). No W5 candidate uses other assets.
hypotheses.why_distinct: The only on-disk-buildable working-capital-efficiency proxy in the program; explicitly a stopgap for DATA-ASK #6 (receivables/DSO split) and retired the day that lands.
hypotheses.refinement: On the ~750-firm CF subset: subtract cumulative net cash flow from other-assets drift (removes the cash-pile contamination) - cleaner but subset-limited; run as disclosed refinement only.
hypotheses.data_status: buildable-now (other assets 49,280 rows, sales 48,271; proxy coarseness disclosed)

hypotheses.name: ROIIC - realized return on INCREMENTAL capital
hypotheses.mechanism: Capital-allocation quality, directly: did the last three years of capital deployment actually produce operating profit? The asset-growth anomaly (survivor leg) says growth is on average bad; ROIIC asks whether the PRODUCTIVITY of that growth separates good growers from empire-builders. Explicit caution: the adjacent LEVEL constructs are killed wrong-sign (reinvestment_runway -0.41, ROCE-streak -0.79: realized-quality LEVELS are priced-for-perfection) - the live question is whether the MARGINAL return is also priced.
hypotheses.construction: ROIIC_3Y = (operating profit_t - operating profit_{t-3}) / (invested_capital_t - invested_capital_{t-3}), invested_capital = total assets - investments - other liabilities (operating-capital proxy from on-disk fields); require denominator > 5% of invested_capital_{t-3} (real deployment happened) and operating profit_{t-3} > 0. Winsorize at [-1, 2]. Factor = z_cs(ROIIC), long HIGH. Fields: operating profit, total assets, investments, other liabilities. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_sign: + nominally; PRE-REGISTERED TWO-SIDED READ given the priced-for-perfection anti-findings - a robust NEGATIVE sign is itself a decision-relevant result (marginal quality also priced -> close the capital-allocation-level lane for good)
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Likely LINEAR/concave (quality-level family showed skew -1.0 to -1.2); not a convexity bet - included for the capital-allocation lane, graded on incremental-IC and drop-one, with shape reported.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg_and_w5: KILL-CHEAP preconditions before any harness spend: corr vs the killed reinvestment_runway construct > 0.6 -> kill; corr vs bs_asset_growth or QMJ > 0.6 -> kill. No W5 overlap (no W5 idea scores capital productivity).
hypotheses.why_distinct: Marginal (flow) capital productivity vs the killed level/streak constructs; the composition-agnostic complement to W5-05 (which asked WHERE the rupee went, not what it EARNED).
hypotheses.refinement: Conditional variant WITHIN high-asset-growth tercile only (does ROIIC rescue good growers from the asset-growth penalty?) - run only if base passes gates and the kill-cheap corrs clear.

hypotheses.name: Repurchase-when-cheap discipline (issuance-timing skill)
hypotheses.mechanism: Buyback discipline, on-disk: the issuance survivor leg is unconditional (any equity-capital shrink is good). Allocation SKILL is conditional - shrinking equity when the stock is CHEAP (high EY) compounds per-share value; issuing when EXPENSIVE is smart selling. Timing-conditional issuance isolates management's capital-market judgment from mechanical payout capacity.
hypotheses.construction: issuance_3Y = d_ln(equity capital adj proxy, 3Y) (same field basis as bs_issuance leg, bonus/split noise disclosed); timing = -z_cs(issuance_3Y) * sign_alignment, where sign_alignment = +1 if (shrink AND own-EY in top tercile of universe at shrink year) or (issue AND own-EY in bottom tercile), else 0. Factor = z_cs(timing), long disciplined timers. Fields: equity capital, eps in rs / net profit + price (EY from the existing value-leg pipeline).
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Mildly defensive (disciplined allocators hold up in derates); shape reported, no convexity claim.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg_and_w5: KILL-CHEAP: corr vs bs_issuance > 0.7 -> kill without further spend (it would be the same leg). Uses EY in construction -> mandatory residualization vs value_EY + corr check < 0.5. Forced-interaction prior is poor (GARP lesson) - this is condition-GATED not multiplied, but the prior is honestly M-grade at best. No W5 overlap.
hypotheses.why_distinct: The requested buyback-discipline mechanism; conditional-timing estimand vs the unconditional issuance survivor - nothing in the corpus scores WHEN managements transact in their own stock.
hypotheses.data_status: buildable-now (equity capital 49,355 rows + existing EY pipeline; share-count proxy noise ~8% disclosed, same as bs_issuance)

hypotheses.name: Concall prepared-vs-Q&A tone delta (evasion under questioning) - PILOT
hypotheses.mechanism: The largest untouched on-disk data asset (coverage map: 'NLP tone... data READY, 125K news + 1,042 MiMIC calls'). Management controls the prepared remarks but not the Q&A: a large negative tone/specificity gap between scripted and unscripted sections (hedging density, non-answer rate, numeric-specificity drop) is a bluff tell that no fundamentals field can see. Vakrangee-class narrative risk lives exactly here.
hypotheses.construction: On the 139-company text-ready MiMIC subset (2015-24): per call, tone_delta = specificity/hedging score(Q&A answers) - score(prepared remarks), using lexicon-based scoring (Loughran-McDonald + hedging lexicon); PRECONDITION: fix the W4 P0 speaker-attribution bug (regex miscounted analyst questions as mgmt commitments) before any scoring. Factor = z_cs(mean tone_delta, trailing 4 calls), long HIGH (candid under questioning). PIT: call date + 1 day.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Convex-via-avoidance expected (evasive-mgmt names carry event tail risk); pilot graded on shape + episode behavior, NOT significance (139 firms, clustered - same pilot discipline as W5-09).
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg_and_w5: Text channel - orthogonal to all 7 legs and all W5 candidates by data source. vs the W4 mgmt-credibility build-spec (guidance-vs-delivery): that scores PROMISES against OUTCOMES across calls; this scores behavior WITHIN a single call - different estimand, shared corpus, shared P0-bugfix precondition.
hypotheses.why_distinct: Only behavioral/text mechanism in the batch; genuinely non-crowded in India (no vendor sells prepared-vs-Q&A deltas on NSE names).
hypotheses.refinement: None at pilot stage. Full test needs the 264-name PDF OCR (DATA-ASK #7).
hypotheses.data_status: buildable-pilot (139-firm MiMIC subset on disk; graded on shape, upgrade blocked on OCR data-ask)

batch_summary.mechanism_lanes: asset-authenticity reconciliation (cash-yield, CWIP-conversion), P&L mix drift (diworsification), cash debt-serviceability (extend-and-pretend), counterparty certification (tax authority - the W5-02 template), working-capital efficiency proxy, marginal capital productivity (ROIIC), issuance-timing skill (buyback discipline), management candor under questioning (text)
